headlines.title: Dowman sees red as Arsenal dumped out, but did Arteta go too far?
headlines.description: A shocking defeat, a red card card, a penalty-shootout and a drone tell the story of Arsenal's dramatic loss to League Two Fleetwood Town in the last-16 of the Carabao Cup.

headlines.title: 'Biggest night in club's history' for fearless Fleetwood
headlines.description: A whopping 83 league places separated Fleetwood from Arsenal, yet the hosts booked their place in the Carabao Cup quarter-final thanks to their penalty shootout win over the Gunners.

headlines.title: Where does Fleetwood beating Arsenal rank in biggest cup upsets?
headlines.description: BBC Sport looks at the history of the biggest FA Cup and League Cup upsets after Fleetwood Town's shock win against Arsenal.
